status.refreshing: Databases refresh in progress, please wait…
rows.truncated: Showing the first {max} of {total} — keep typing to narrow.
installed.selfCannotRemove: The package manager cannot remove itself while it is running.
installed.pacmanCannotRemove: Removing pacman would leave this system unable to install or update anything.
installed.bootCannotRemove: Removing {name} would leave this system unable to boot.
installed.initramfsCannotRemove: Removing {name} would leave the next kernel update without an initramfs.
aelum.dbError: The [aelum] database could not be read
aelum.noRepoBody: Enable it in pacman.conf, then use the refresh button to download its package list.
aur.idleBody: The AUR is not one of this system's repositories. Nothing is fetched until you search it.
aur.warn: Anyone can publish on the Arch User Repository (AUR): nothing is reviewed or guaranteed by Arch Linux, and installing builds the package on this machine.
aur.votesTip: {votes} votes in the AUR — how many people approved this package. Prefer well-voted, current recipes.
aur.empty: No AUR package matches that search
aur.noBuildTools: Building AUR packages needs base-devel, which is not installed.
aur.buildNote: The AUR ships no binaries: this builds a community-published, unreviewed recipe on this machine.
aur.cleanupDeps: Removing build-time dependencies no longer needed
aur.cleanupFailed: The build-time dependencies could not be removed
aur.checkTip: Asks the AUR whether the packages this system installed outside its repositories have a newer version. Nothing is fetched until you press this.
aur.checkNone: Nothing is installed outside the repositories
aur.checkNoneBody: Every package on this system came from a repository, so there is nothing to ask the AUR about.
aur.checkUpToDate: Everything from the AUR is up to date
aur.checkUpToDateOne: No new version for {count} package installed outside the repositories was found.
aur.checkUpToDateMany: No new versions for {count} packages installed outside the repositories were found.
firmware.checkTip: Ask fwupd whether your devices have firmware updates
firmware.idleBody: fwupd checks your devices — storage, docks, trackers — against the firmware their makers publish.
firmware.noneBody: fwupd asks the firmware service about your devices and installs the updates it publishes.
firmware.refreshFailed: The update service could not be reached — the answer uses what is already on this machine.
firmware.rebootNeeded: A firmware update waits for a restart
firmware.updateBodyOne: {name} will be written to new firmware.
firmware.updateBodyMany: {count} devices will be written to new firmware: {names}
firmware.updateNote: Firmware writes cannot be undone; some updates restart the machine on their own. Save your work.

fileopen.extractTo: The contents will be extracted to {folder}.
txnlog.title: Operation
txn.timedOut: Sync timed out after {seconds} seconds — the mirrors may be unreachable. Try Update mirrors in the menu, then refresh again.

chooser.title: Choose a provider
chooser.body: These packages need a provider chosen. Pick which package answers each requirement — the first one is what would be installed by default.
mirrors.title: Update mirrors
mirrors.body: Update mirrors with the fastest ones for your country.
mirrors.willInstall: This installs reflector first — the program that ranks mirrors by speed.
keyring.title: Repair the signing keys?
keyring.body: Every package this system installs is checked against these keys. The keys are rebuilt from the key files already on this machine. No package is added or removed.
